package.author: Gram Editor
package.description: A code editor for humanoid apes and grumpy toads

en-US.author: Gram Editor
en-US.description: A code editor for humanoid apes and grumpy toads
en-US.longDescription: Gram is a powerful and modern source code editor. It features solid performance and is highly configurable, yet comes with batteries included out of the box. Gram supports many popular programming languages and file formats, and can use Zed extensions to support additional languages. Other features include built-in documentation, debugger support via the DAP protocol, source control using git and more. Gram started as a fork of the Zed editor.
en-US.name: Gram
en-US.releaseNotes:
[3.5.0] - 2026-11-09
Added
- Add used memory to the language server menu (zed#48226)
- Add path to the language server menu (zed#47037)
- Auto-close parentheses and brackets inside python f-strings
- Add Helix amp jump support to Vim mode (zed#55492)
- Add support for the zk zettelkasten/markdown LSP
- Hide bar below title bar menu when there is nothing to put in it (#688) by @zachrammell
- Support submodules and binary files in git diff view (#675) by @Emilinya
Changed
- Require exec permission for extensions to run npm info
- Rename gram::open_performance_profiler to dev::open_profiler
- UI elements now use the default cursor when hovered (#710) by @kramo
Fixed
- Support smooth scroll in lists (settings, markdown preview, docs etc.)
- Reset scroll position when navigating in docs
- Show readable version in the language server menu (zed#49835)
- Improve UI of the language server submenu (zed#50160)
- Fix incorrect memory display in the language server menu on Linux (zed#48245)
- Switch to heck for case conversion to fix strange snake casing (#680)
- Don't require extensions to declare chmod +x as an exec capability
- Fix incorrect arguments to tombi TOML LSP after download
- Fix capturing environment in Powershell/Windows (#683) by @ognevny
- Fix helix select next match panic when search wraps around (zed#51642) (#694)
- Fix crash while moving through selections in helix mode (zed#52922) (#694)
- Restore code outline support for diff files (#580) by @jqslr
- Fix Helix amp jump history for short jumps (zed#66141) (#695)
- Fix non-ASCII path:line:column navigation (zed#51238)
- Fix line:column displaying wrong column for non-ASCII (#711)
- Don't unload fonts that can be used as fallback

zh-CN.description: 为人类猿和暴躁蟾蜍打造的代码编辑器。
zh-CN.longDescription: Gram 是一款强大的现代源代码编辑器。它性能出色、可高度配置，同时开箱即用地内置了大量功能。Gram 支持许多流行的编程语言和文件格式，并可以使用 Zed 扩展来支持更多语言。其他功能包括内置文档、通过 DAP 协议提供的调试器支持、基于 git 的版本控制等。Gram 最初是 Zed 编辑器的一个分支。
